venues.name: Highbury Fields
venues.description: Tennis among the trees in Islington’s largest park. Eleven outdoor courts, with pay-and-play bookings through Better.
venues.fees: Adult, one hour: £12.35 non-member, £10.60 Better Pay As You Go member (same price peak and off-peak). Junior 11–17, off-peak only: £5.55 non-member, £4.40 member. Junior off-peak is 8am–6pm Monday to Friday and all day at weekends. Over-60s with a Better Adult Senior Membership play free 8am–4pm Monday to Friday; otherwise £10.60.
venues.accessNote: Public pay-and-play. Prices, available times and booking rules are set by Better.

approach.destination: Highbury Fields Tennis Courts, Highbury Grove, London N5
guidance: Courts 1–8 are on the east side of the Fields, between Highbury Place and Highbury Grove.
For courts 9–11, the council describes access from Highbury Terrace or the southern perimeter path connecting to Highbury Place.

venues.name: Islington Tennis Centre
venues.description: A year-round place to play, with six indoor cushioned acrylic courts and two outdoor macadam courts. You don’t need a membership to book.
venues.hours: Centre open Monday to Thursday 7am–11pm; Friday to Sunday 7am–10pm (week of 5 October 2026; some areas vary).
venues.fees: Indoor court, one hour: adults £40.00 non-member, £35.50 member, concession £35.50 peak / £17.40 off-peak; juniors 11–17 £40.00 / £35.50 peak, £17.75 / £14.35 off-peak. Outdoor court, one hour: adults £14.85 non-member, £12.75 member, concession £12.75 peak / £11.15 off-peak; juniors 11–17 £14.85 / £12.75 peak, £6.80 / £5.45 off-peak.
venues.accessNote: Public pay-and-play. Choose Islington Tennis Centre & Gym in Better’s booking service. Indoor and outdoor courts have separate availability and prices.

approach.destination: Islington Tennis Centre and Gym, Market Road, London N7 9PL
guidance: Better describes the centre as a short walk from Caledonian Road station. Head to the centre on Market Road.

venues.name: Rosemary Gardens
venues.description: Two tennis courts tucked into a leafy neighbourhood park, just north of Regent’s Canal. Court bookings are managed by Better.
venues.hours: Tennis courts: Monday to Friday 8am–9pm; Saturday and Sunday 8am–7pm.
venues.fees: Adult, one hour: £12.35 non-member, £10.60 Better Pay As You Go member (same price peak and off-peak). Junior 11–17, off-peak only: £5.55 non-member, £4.40 member. Junior off-peak is 8am–6pm Monday to Friday and all day at weekends. Over-60 Pay As You Go members play free off-peak (8am–4pm Monday to Friday).
venues.accessNote: Public pay-and-play. There are steps to the tennis courts. Coaching is also available through Tennis for All; coaching and court hire are separate.

approach.destination: Rosemary Gardens Tennis Courts, Southgate Road, London N1 3JP
guidance: The council lists Essex Road as the nearby train station and Southgate Road for the park. The tennis courts have stepped access.

venues.name: Tufnell Park
venues.description: Two outdoor courts beside the playing fields, near the northern edge of Islington. Book a court through Better.
venues.fees: Adult, one hour: £12.35 non-member, £10.60 Better Pay As You Go member (same price peak and off-peak). Junior 11–17, off-peak only: £5.55 non-member, £4.40 member. Junior off-peak is 8am–6pm Monday to Friday and all day at weekends. Over-60s with a Better Adult Senior Membership play free 8am–4pm Monday to Friday; otherwise £10.60.
venues.accessNote: Public pay-and-play. Better lists opening hours from 8am until dusk; check its calendar for court times.

approach.destination: Tufnell Park Playing Fields, Campdale Road, London N7 0EB
guidance: The council identifies the main park entrance on Campdale Road and a path beside the tennis courts.

venues.name: Spa Fields
venues.description: A shared ball court with tennis nets, also used for football and basketball. Step-free access is available.
venues.hours: Open during the park's opening hours, which the council publishes on its parks opening times page.
venues.fees: Free; the court cannot be booked.
venues.accessNote: Free play. The council says this court cannot be booked. Availability depends on other park users.

approach.destination: Spa Fields, Skinner Street, London EC1
guidance: The council lists Farringdon and Angel for the park. Its shared ball court has step-free access and is free-play.

venues.name: Elizabeth Garrett Anderson School
venues.description: The school lists four outdoor tennis courts among its PE facilities. Public tennis hire has not been verified.
venues.accessNote: Restricted school facilities. A listing does not give permission to enter. Contact the school about any community access.

venues.name: Coolhurst Tennis & Squash Club
venues.address: Coolhurst Road, Crouch End, London N8 8EY
venues.description: A nearby members’ club in Crouch End, outside Islington. Fourteen tennis courts, with two covered for the winter months.
venues.accessNote: Membership is subject to availability; the club currently advertises a waiting list. Some coaching is open to non-members.

venues.name: Barbican Lawn Tennis Club
venues.address: City of London School for Girls, St Giles Terrace, London EC2Y 8BB
venues.description: A Barbican residents’ club using two hard courts owned by the City of London School for Girls. Outside Islington, in the City of London.
venues.accessNote: Membership is limited to Barbican Estate residents. Accompanied guests may play under club rules, outside specified school hours. No public pay-and-play access.

services.name: Tennis Coaching with Karen
services.description: Supportive coaching for beginners, returning players and improvers at Highbury Fields, with Karen Dawson. Explore private lessons and group coaching.
services.note: Enquire with the coach about the right level, current sessions and prices.

services.name: Better tennis courses
services.description: Adult courses from beginner to advanced, plus junior tennis from tots to teens. Find the right level and check spaces with Better.
services.note: Course registration is separate from casual court hire. Current timetables and availability are held by Better.

services.name: James Wells Tennis
services.description: Private lessons for juniors, adults and seniors on Islington Tennis Centre’s indoor and outdoor courts, from beginner to competitive level.
services.note: Arrange lessons directly with the coach. Equipment lending for a first lesson is described on his website.

services.name: Tennis for All
services.description: Year-round community coaching for adults and juniors at Rosemary Gardens, with equipment provided. Explore beginner-friendly lessons and the current programme.
services.note: The programme includes free and low-cost activities, with different eligibility and booking rules. Check each session with the provider.

services.name: Wigmore Sports
services.description: A specialist racket-sports shop with adult and junior tennis rackets, footwear, clothing and accessories. In-store services include restringing, regripping and racket customisation; ask the team about demo rackets.
services.note: Check opening hours, demo terms and stringing turnaround directly before travelling. Shop details checked 25 September 2026; map position is approximate.

services.name: Hackney Tennis Shop
services.address: Clissold Park Tennis Pavilion, 3 Queen Elizabeth’s Walk, London N16 0BF
services.description: A specialist tennis shop at Clissold Park for adult and junior rackets, balls, grips and racket stringing. Just outside Islington in Hackney.
services.note: Check opening hours, current stock and stringing turnaround with the shop before travelling.

services.name: Sweet Spot Stringer
services.description: Racket stringing, regripping and setup advice, with collection and delivery serving Islington and neighbouring areas.
services.note: A collection service, not a mapped walk-in shop. Arrange collection and confirm turnaround directly.

play.name: Weekend mix-ins
play.venueContext: Meet on the Highbury Fields courts.
play.description: Volunteer-run doubles where you can arrive on your own and meet other local players. Places are first come, subject to capacity and weather.
play.level: Basic serving and rallying skills recommended
play.access: Adults 18+ · Drop-in · A session fee applies
play.note: Local pages disagree on Sunday times, court numbers and fees. Confirm the current arrangements with the organiser before travelling. This is separate from club membership.

play.name: Social doubles, 50+
play.description: Meet other players through doubles matches arranged by the reception team. Balls are supplied, and rackets can be borrowed.
play.access: Age 50+ · Check booking and prices with Better
play.note: These are Better’s published weekly times, not confirmed upcoming events. Check the operator’s current schedule and availability.

play.name: Adult social doubles
play.summary: Pay as you go · Intermediate recommended
play.description: Join rotating doubles matches arranged by the reception team. Equipment is available to borrow.
play.note: Published weekly timetable, not live availability. Monday and Wednesday 50+ sessions are listed separately.

play.name: North London Lob-sters
play.venueContext: This listing highlights their Rosemary Gardens session; the group also plays elsewhere in North London.
play.description: A welcoming tennis community with social doubles and opportunities to get to know other players. Join through the organiser’s Spond group.
play.level: All abilities for the Rosemary session
play.access: Join the group and check session booking requirements
play.note: Confirm the next session, eligibility, cost and spaces through the organiser. A listing here does not reserve a place.

sources.label: Tennis for All — North London Lob-sters

play.name: Find an opponent
play.venueContext: These courts anchor league areas listed by the LTA. Players arrange their match venue and time together.
play.description: Join a local league to meet opponents of a similar standard, then arrange matches around your schedules. Use the official app to choose a local league and round.
play.level: Grouped by playing standard · Check local league options
play.when: Arrange match times with your opponents
play.access: Adults 18+ · LTA account and paid league entry
play.note: Court hire is separate. The app holds current round dates and entry availability; no open round or immediate match is promised here.
play.actionLabel: Find a league with the LTA

play.name: Meet players through a club
play.venueContext: The club plays on Highbury Fields’ public courts.
play.description: Meet other players through club practice, doubles teams and returners sessions. Request an assessment so the club can suggest an appropriate group.
play.when: Regular club sessions · Arrange an assessment first
play.access: Adult club · Membership and session costs apply
play.note: The club does not teach complete beginners or children. Joining and assessment availability are confirmed by the club, not this guide.

iconicLondonClubs.access: A private members’ club. Museum visits and guided tours are open to visitors; court access is restricted.

iconicLondonClubs.access: A private members’ club. Follow the Championships for spectator information; the club shop welcomes visitors.
